extracted.name: Classic Hawaiian Loco Moco with Rich Brown Gravy
extracted.description: Hawaiian comfort food favorite featuring a seasoned hamburger patty served over fluffy white rice, smothered in a rich brown gravy and topped with a perfectly cooked fried egg. Simple, hearty, and packed with flavor, this island classic is the ultimate stick-to-your-ribs meal that’s perfect for lunch or dinner. #CookpadApron2026
instruction_lines: Cook 2 cups of white rice according to package instructions.
Shape ground beef into 4 patties, season with salt and pepper.
Slice mushrooms. Sauté in 2 tbsp oil until golden, then remove from pan.
Pan-fry beef patties until cooked through. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, add 2 tbsp flour and cook briefly. Gradually add 1 cup vegetable stock, 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, and 2 tbsp soy sauce, stirring to make gravy.
Return mushrooms to the gravy and simmer until thickened.
Serve each plate with rice, a beef patty, mushroom gravy, and a fried egg on top.
